title: Calibration range microscope
description: Change the corpus, clipping policy, and granularity to see the exact INT8 mapping and where information is lost.
note: All distributions are a transparent teaching fixture. They illustrate quantization arithmetic, not expected quality for a real model.

policies.label: Observed full range
policies.detail: Represent every observed calibration value; widest step, no calibration-tail clipping.

policies.label: Central 99.9%
policies.detail: Use a tighter range and accept about 10 clipped calibration values per 10,000.

policies.label: Central 99%
policies.detail: Use the finest step in this fixture and accept about 100 clipped calibration values per 10,000.

scenarios.label: Typical inputs only
scenarios.detail: The calibration corpus omits the rare glare slice seen in production.

scenarios.label: Representative mixture
scenarios.detail: Common inputs and the rare glare slice are both present.

scenarios.label: Stale calibration corpus
scenarios.detail: A new sensor pipeline extends the production activation range beyond calibration.
